description: Ministry of Labour & Trade Union Relations - The Industrial Disputes between Mr. R. P. A. Sagara and Sri Lanka Ports Authority and  two other notices
categorisation: This gazette content consists of orders made under the Industrial Disputes Act, appointing arbitrators to settle specific industrial disputes. It references specific legislative enactments (Chapter 131 of the Legislative Enactments of Ceylon) and amendments to this act. The content is primarily about implementing legal/regulatory procedures for dispute resolution under existing labor legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory Gazette. While a minister is named, this is in the context of exercising statutory powers rather than describing detailed portfolio responsibilities, so it does not qualify as a Hybrid (Type 3) gazette.
